body:
## What

Add a shared **test-mode strip** to LibKa0s so every Ka0s addon with a window can show the same notice while test mode is on.

Ka0s Drop Watcher (`DropWatcher/modules/Window.lua`, `buildBanner`) draws it today: a full-width strip between the filter bar and the window body. It has a translucent warning-yellow fill (the warn tone at 12% alpha), the Media catalog's `info` icon and one line of small gold text saying what test mode is doing, for example *"TEST MODE: placeholder drops in every state. Nothing is whispered. Combat ends it."* It also has a tooltip and is hidden when test mode is off.

The owner likes it and wants it in the other window addons. To avoid hand-rolling it in each one, it should live in the library first.

## Proposal

- Add a Widgets (or Core) helper along the lines of `MakeTestStrip(parent, opts) -> strip`, where `opts` holds `text`, `tooltip` and an optional `icon` key. The strip should have `:SetShown(bool)` and `:SetText(s)`, and take its colors from the shared tone table.
- The host anchors it, usually below the filter bar, and shifts its body down by the strip's height while the strip is shown.
- Document it in `docs/api/`, and add a headless test for its build and its show/hide.

## Adopters

Each addon gets its own adoption issue:
- LootHistory
- BankLedger
- MultiMeters
- DropWatcher, which replaces its in-addon copy once this ships.

WhatGroup and AuraMaster are left out on purpose:
- WhatGroup's test-mode popup is compact and already says it is showing sample data.
- AuraMaster's test mode draws auras on screen and has no window.

title: Shared test-mode strip widget (from DropWatcher) for window addons
